summary: 51Talk Online Education Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing unaudited second-quarter 2026 results, its routine quarterly earnings disclosure as a foreign private issuer. Gross billings rose 38.1% year over year to US$39.3 million, net revenues climbed 58.8% to US$32.4 million, active students grew 51.3% to about 138,100, and operating cash inflow was US$4.9 million. Management highlighted the July 1 launch of Global Communicator with Oxford University Press and a third-quarter 2026 investment stance targeting profitability. No transaction, shareholder action, or special-situation event is present; there is no deal to trade.
